easy.question: Which company launched the Gemini 4 Neon AI model to target complex software engineering and science workflows?
easy.explanation: Google launched its new AI model, Gemini 4 Neon, targeted at complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

easy.question: Which company unveiled the Inkling 2 Mini, a 26-billion-parameter open-weight AI model designed to run locally on MacBooks?
easy.explanation: Thinking Machines Lab launched Inkling 2 Mini, a 26-billion-parameter open-weight AI model that runs locally on consumer hardware.

easy.question: Which startup filed a lawsuit against Apple in India alleging that the iPhone's NameDrop feature infringes its patented contact-sharing technology?
easy.explanation: GG Technologies, the startup behind StayTouch, sued Apple in India over the tap-to-share contacts feature.

easy.question: Which organization proposed a new EU budget draft featuring a 3% digital tax targeting tech companies?
easy.explanation: European Council President Antonio Costa proposed a new EU budget draft introducing a digital tax targeting major tech companies.

easy.question: Which former Bewakoof cofounder launched an AI-powered shopping assistant named Save8?
easy.explanation: Bewakoof cofounder and former CEO Prabhkiran Singh has launched Save8, an AI-powered shopping assistant.

easy.question: Which company announced a $5 million funding commitment to IIT Kharagpur for advanced applied AI research?
easy.explanation: Google announced it will provide IIT Kharagpur with $5 million to develop and accelerate advanced AI research.

easy.question: Which company officially entered the foldable smartphone market with the launch of the iPhone Duo?
easy.explanation: Apple has officially entered the foldable smartphone market with the launch of its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo.

easy.question: Which company partnered with Salesforce to launch Copilotforce, connecting CRM data directly with Microsoft Copilot?
easy.explanation: Salesforce and Microsoft launched Copilotforce, a service integrating Salesforce CRM data directly with Microsoft Copilot.

easy.question: Which startup announced an $18 million Series B funding round led by Left Lane Capital and BIG Capital?
easy.explanation: Indian bubble tea and Korean street food brand Boba Bhai raised $18 million in a Series B funding round led by Left Lane Capital and BIG Capital.

easy.question: Which company announced the $300 wearable AI device named Muse Charm while delaying its smartwatch release to 2027?
easy.explanation: Meta is preparing to launch a $300 wearable AI device named Muse Charm while delaying its planned smartwatch release to 2027.

easy.question: Which organization launched the Oister Deep Tech Fund targeting ₹600 crore to back growth-stage deeptech startups?
easy.explanation: Oister Global has launched the Oister Deep Tech Fund with a potential target of ₹600 crore.

easy.question: Which Chinese food delivery company released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model?
easy.explanation: Chinese food delivery company Meituan released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model.

easy.question: Which data protection authority fined Meta €805 million for unauthorized access to Android users' photo galleries?
easy.explanation: Italy’s Data Protection Authority fined Meta €805 million for accessing Android users' photo galleries via Facebook without explicit consent.

easy.question: Which company launched its first native macOS photo editor named VSCO Studio Pro Desktop?
easy.explanation: VSCO launched its first native macOS photo editor, VSCO Studio Pro Desktop, expanding into direct competition with Adobe's Lightroom.

easy.question: Which company announced the Lumix SHX1, its first box-style compact cinema camera recording Blackmagic RAW?
easy.explanation: Panasonic announced the Lumix SHX1, its first box-style compact cinema camera and the first to bear the Lumix branding since integrating divisions.

medium.question: What is the API input token pricing for OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol model according to Microsoft's worldwide rollout?
medium.explanation: Sol is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 for output, compared to $8 for input and $40 for output for Astra.

medium.question: Which model did Google launch to compete directly against Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol?
medium.explanation: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon targeted at complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows to compete against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol.

medium.question: What was the success rate of adversarial distillation attacks pulling protected reasoning from OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra model after safeguards were updated?
medium.explanation: OpenAI updated its safeguards to reduce the success rate of adversarial distillation attacks pulling protected reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra down to 0.2%.

medium.question: For how many hours did an unauthorized model swap serve customer requests on a hosted DeepSeek deployment?
medium.explanation: Prime Intellect disclosed an unauthorized model swap where a modified DeepSeek V4.1 Flash served customer requests for 53 hours and 11 minutes.

medium.question: What is the parameter count of the open-weight Inkling 2 Mini model released by Thinking Machines Lab?
medium.explanation: Thinking Machines Lab launched Inkling 2 Mini, a 26-billion-parameter open-weight AI model that runs locally on consumer hardware with 32GB of RAM.

medium.question: What annual digital tax rate did European Council President Antonio Costa propose for tech companies in the new EU budget draft?
medium.explanation: The draft introduces a digital tax requiring covered companies to pay an annual contribution of 3% on net turnover derived from digital activities.

medium.question: How much funding did Google announce it will provide to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research?
medium.explanation: Google announced it will provide IIT Kharagpur with $5 million (about Rs 46 crore) to develop and accelerate advanced AI research.

medium.question: What is the name of Meta's upcoming pocket-sized wearable AI device priced at $300?
medium.explanation: Meta is preparing to launch a $300 wearable AI device named Muse Charm while delaying its planned smartwatch release to 2027.

medium.question: Which company filed a lawsuit against Apple in India over the NameDrop contact-sharing feature, seeking ₹15 billion in damages?
medium.explanation: GG Technologies, the startup behind StayTouch, is suing Apple in India alleging the iPhone maker's NameDrop feature infringes its patented technology.

medium.question: What was the valuation of robotics startup Genesis AI following its $500 million Series A funding round?
medium.explanation: Robotics startup Genesis AI raised $500 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures, and Eclipse at a $3.5 billion post-money valuation.

medium.question: What percentage of PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) improvement did OpenAI's AI models achieve when optimizing AMD's upcoming GPU design?
medium.explanation: OpenAI announced that its undisclosed AI models optimized AMD's upcoming flagship GPU and CPU designs, achieving up to a 14% PPA improvement in GPU circuitry.

medium.question: How much was Meta fined by Italy’s Data Protection Authority for unauthorized access to users' phone-stored photos?
medium.explanation: Italy’s Data Protection Authority fined Meta €805 million ($887 million) for accessing Android users' photo galleries via Facebook without explicit, informed consent.

medium.question: What is the new participant limit for a single group chat on WhatsApp following its recent capacity increase?
medium.explanation: WhatsApp increased the limit on the number of members that can participate in a group chat from 1,024 to 1,500.

medium.question: Which model processed 61.2 trillion tokens on OpenRouter in a single week, leading all models while its provider began rationing free chats?
medium.explanation: DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash 1017 model processed 61.2 trillion tokens on OpenRouter in a single week, leading all models, while DeepSeek began rationing its free consumer chatbot.

medium.question: What score did OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra post on the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI)?
medium.explanation: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra has posted a score of 174 on the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI), tying it with Anthropic's release.
